::: {.milestone-banner}
**Milestone — The system in production.** [What makes it good](../milestones.qmd#m329)
:::

::: {.why}
The strategy running by itself against a real broker's paper account, and the test is whether it survives a week you do not touch it, which starts today rather than ends today.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Have the full pipeline run on a schedule with logging, monitoring, alerting and reconciliation, unattended.
- Have a runbook covering the failures that will happen, written before they do.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Finish reports/milestone-10-production.md: the scheduled steps with their success conditions, the four monitors with calibrated thresholds, the reconciliation report with its categories, and the runbook. Include the log excerpt from the first failure and how you diagnosed it, since that is the most convincing part.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Set the real test running: commit to not touching the system for the next week and note the date. The milestone's claim is that it survives a week unattended, and you cannot assert that today. Write the date the claim can be checked and put it in the capstone's checklist.
:::
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Timed mixed set, eighth sitting: five problems in fifteen minutes. Score and plot all eight.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> A production question: your strategy has been live six weeks and is underperforming the backtest by 40 basis points a month. List the diagnoses in the order you would test them, out loud, in two minutes. There is a correct ordering and it starts with the cheapest checks.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Why are you leaving academia, third attempt, recorded. Compare against days 287 and 308. By now it should be under forty-five seconds and should contain one concrete thing about the work rather than about the institution.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 10 closes the production phase. The book runs on a schedule against a paper account with monitoring, reconciliation and a runbook, and the track record it produces from here is the one the capstone reports without adjustment.
:::
